name: District police portals of Sylhet Range (Moulvibazar, Habiganj, Sunamganj)
organization: Bangladesh Police — district police units of Sylhet Range
attribution: District and thana police portals (police.<district>.gov.bd, police.<upazila>.<district>.gov.bd)
notes: No licence stated. SP offices from the Superintendent's officer card; thanas from each upazila's thana portal officer cards (office landline, OC's police official mobile, *.gov.bd e-mail). Personal e-mails, other mobiles and officers' names are not copied. Sylhet Range (Range DIG's office, policedig.sylhetdiv.gov.bd) covers the 4 districts of the division; Sylhet District is in SYLHET_POLICE_2026 and Sylhet city's SMP thanas in SYLHET_METRO_POLICE_THANAS_2026. Thanas that are not upazilas have no portal here. Unavailable this run: Sunamganj: portal police.shantiganj.sunamganj.gov.bd did not respond; Sunamganj: portal police.madhyanagar.sunamganj.gov.bd: 'Site is not available: police.madhyanagar.sunamganj.gov.bd'
